answer: Require each agent to prove a hardware-entropy fingerprint before joining: a VDF seed from GPU ring-oscillator jitter, unique per chip and re-measured each epoch. Cloning an identity means buying another GPU, so a 200-clone farm needs 200 cards, $60,000. One exposed clone blacklists its fingerprint across the garden of registries. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 newcomers shared four identical jitter profiles in 90 seconds; all 132 were slashed 100%, cedar-rooted sponsor bonds burned. A walnut test flags fingerprints within 0.1% jitter as one machine.
